Since then, we've grown to become the largest beach store chain in the Southeastern United States, with 34 locations in Florida and Alabama. Our mission is simple: provide our customers with the best selection of high-quality products at affordable prices. We believe that everyone should have access to the best beach gear and souvenirs, whether you're a local or just visiting for the first time. We're proud to offer a wide variety of products that cater to all your beach-related needs. From bathing suits to beach towels, sunglasses to sunscreen, we've got everything you need to make your beach vacation unforgettable. We also offer a huge selection of souvenirs, including T-shirts, hats, and beach-themed home decor, so you can take a piece of the beach home with you. We carry a wide range of products from top brands like Fox, Roxy, Columbia, Tommy Bahama, Quicksilver, Hurley, Salt Life, and Simply Southern, ensuring that you have access to the latest trends and styles. At Alvin's Island, we're committed to providing our customers with the best possible shopping experience. Our friendly and knowledgeable staff are always on hand to answer any questions you may have and help you find exactly what you're looking for. We're also dedicated to providing high-quality products at affordable prices, so you can enjoy your beach vacation without breaking the bank. Thank you for choosing Alvin's Island for all your beach needs. name: Crave Cookies
subtitle: Home of the Deep Dish Cookie. Calories are units of joy. Make yours count.
description: Crave founder Trent didn't start out trying to revolutionize cookies. He started by rebuilding his relationship with food itself. After years trapped by an eating disorder that reduced every meal to numbers and fear, he made a decision: calories aren't just units of measurement. They're units of joy. In his kitchen, recipe after recipe, he built a philosophy: if you're going to indulge, make it extraordinary. No regret. No mediocrity. But as Crave grew, traditional cookies kept limiting what we could create. Too flat. Too fragile. Unable to hold molten centers, loaded toppings, or creative fillings. So we designed custom curved-edge pans inspired by deep-dish pizza and created something entirely new: Deep Dish Cookies. Crave created the deep-dish cookie. Each one is baked in a custom mold for height, texture, and the perfect gooey center. We rotate flavors constantly, treat every customer like family, and keep hospitality at the heart of every store. We use real butter, premium chocolate, and ingredients you'd recognize from your own kitchen. Our Crave Chocolate Chip has won every blind taste test we've entered because we obsessed over ratios and refused to compromise.

Our mission is to strengthen our relationship with our customers by combining the values of old fashioned community banking that focus on individualized customer service with innovative, competitive banking products and trust and brokerage services. Originally founded in 1883 as American Savings, the bank was taken over in 1990 by a group of local investors led by Bank Chairman and CEO Guy T. Williams who shared a vision of building a bank that adhered to the old principles of customer service, yet backed them with the most powerful of today's banking technologies. Gulf Coast's philosophy remains people-oriented. We help our customers get what they want, one on one. Banking today is more complicated, but that doesn't mean it has to be an ordeal. name: Louisiana Lagniappe
subtitle: Gulf Seafood... at its best!
description: For over thirty years we have been known for our Gulf seafood with a Creole flair. The attire is casual, yet an upscale waterfront dining experience is provided for the entire family. Louisiana Lagniappe in Destin was opened in 1984 and established inside Sandpiper Cove condominiums. A loyal following was quickly established, in no small part, to the quality of the food and the attention to detail of the service. Since then, Louisiana Lagniappe has consistently served only the freshest seafood and steaks. The Gulf seafood is prepared with a Creole flair, the attire is casual, yet an upscale waterfront dining experience is provided for the entire family. Open year round, Louisiana Lagniappe is the spot for a memorable dining experience on all levels. With there being hundreds of restaurants in Destin, Lagniappe is consistently ranked in the Top 10 restaurants on TripAdvisor and wins the Award of Excellence every year. In 1999, a second Louisiana Lagniappe was opened in the SanRoc Cay Shopping and Marina Complex in Orange Beach, Alabama. Offering the same fine Louisiana seafood with a Creole flair, the attire is casual, yet an upscale waterfront dining experience is provided for the entire family. Open year round, Louisiana Lagniappe is the spot for a memorable dining experience on all levels. Like our sister restaurant in Destin, FL, Louisiana Lagniappe in Orange Beach is consistently ranked in the Top 10 restaurants on TripAdvisor and wins the Award of Excellence every year.

name: Merchants Bank of Alabama
subtitle: Pointing You Forward
description: We are Merchants Bank. Our purpose is to point people forward. We do this by offering financial tools that provide solutions to help our customers go forward, not only financially, but in life. Merchants Bank of Alabama, a division of SouthPoint Bank, has become Cullman County's go-to locally owned bank by going way out of our way. It's an approach to banking that goes way back to 1907 when we opened in Hanceville, Alabama. Since then we've made a point of changing with the customer. Not just the times. As banking got more impersonal, we offered local decision-makers with real power, long-time employees with a real connection to customers and a person on the other end of your telephone call. Unlike large banks, we're personally, not just financially invested in our communities, with employees and officers that dedicate real time to their towns' charities and causes. Our way of local banking built relationships that ended up building great communities. We've helped open local pharmacies and volunteer fire departments, construction companies and manufacturing plants that employ many of our customers. Our Ag Lending has helped keep Cullman County an agricultural powerhouse and family farming a thriving local tradition. And, we have thrived along with our communities. Now, as a division of SouthPoint Bank, we have approximately $1.8 billion in assets and 11 branches. But our greatest asset, our reputation, makes us the go-to bank in the local markets we serve. In a world of mega-banks, The Merchant's Way still towers. As more big-name banks moved into our communities, we kept our commitment to remain a local community bank, which has kept us a local leader. The Merchants Way has never been about size, but about what is big with our customers. Discover the power of banking with a local bank.

Our ATM network is your platform for growth and service differentiation. From Allpoint, the largest surcharge-free ATM network, to ReadyCode, the cardless way to deliver cash access, NCR Atleos extends delivery of ATM services beyond the branch and into customers' daily lives. Our ATM network is quick, convenient and cost effective, supporting growth and branch transformation initiatives for you, and a better banking experience for your customers. We operate 280K+ ATMs globally, with 55K Allpoint ATMs providing access to 60M consumers. Our ATM branding delivers a differentiated ATM program that builds brand and enhances service delivery. ReadyCode disconnects the card from digital account access, enabling consumers to access cash and receive cash payments from virtually any digital account with a simple numeric code at tens of thousands of ATMs. NCR Atleos LocatorSearch is a leading location services tool with both web and mobile applications that seamlessly displays locations in a modern, customizable interface.

description:
Le NO DIET CLUB is a unique culinary discovery experience in many cities. Seven years after its launch, we've welcomed hundreds of thousands of participants and garnered over 15,000 5-star reviews. Our goal is simple: to introduce you to the best of local cuisine, far removed from the tourist clichés with smile! Quality/quantity food and fun only :)

description: Living with purpose and fueling with food has been a part of our story since the very beginning. We believe each day is filled with promise and possibility. So you can be your best self, live your best life, and rule the day. Our Mission: Inspire people to live a healthy and active lifestyle. Smoothie King was founded in 1973 by Steve Kuhnau, who blended his first Smoothies With A Purpose, mixing various nutrients and proteins with real fruit for custom blends to improve his health. The first U.S. juice bar franchise opened in New Orleans, Louisiana in 1989. Smoothie King went international in 2003, growing to more than 130 locations in South Korea. In 2012, Smoothie King master franchisee Wan Kim took over, continuing Steve's legacy. The brand launched Rule The Day™ in 2019 to capture the journey of wellness, activity and achievement. Today, Smoothie King has grown to over 1,000 locations across the U.S., Republic of Korea, Trinidad & Tobago and the Cayman Islands. We make the Clean Blends promise to our guests, ensuring healthier decisions are made when choosing ingredients for each blend.

name: Parlor Doughnuts
subtitle: Small batches made all day. Coffee roasted daily. A fresh coastal breakfast menu.
description: Parlor Doughnuts was founded by Darrick Hayden, in partnership with Josh Tudela, in February of 2019. Darrick traveled the states extensively with his son's band for several years. During those years, Darrick would seek out the area's best doughnuts and coffee. His appreciation of good doughnuts grew, as his son's appreciation for great coffee grew. With his son, Noah, the two launched a coffee shop in 2015 (Proper Coffee), which flourished, and gave birth to the concept of Parlor Doughnuts. The concept for Parlor Doughnuts grew out of the Hayden's travel, exposure, and the desire to create a new path for the doughnut experience. Layered dough was the clear choice for this unique doughnut shop experience. Parlor offers their Famous Layered Doughnut, which sets them apart from the traditional cake or yeast style. Along with this unique style of doughnut, Parlor seeks to offer something for everyone by offering vegan/gluten friendly, and a keto friendly doughnut, along with a special doughnut for all the pups out there, with their Doggie Doughnut. The brand has expanded to offer breakfast items such as acai bowls, avocado toast, breakfast sandwiches and tacos. And of course, specialty coffee. In February 2019, the dynamic combination of unique doughnuts and great coffee launched in Evansville, IN in a niche little downtown shop. The community's support exploded, exceeding all expectations. Less than a year later, Parlor Doughnuts opened an expansive location on Evansville's east side, including a large dining area and drive-thru service. Additional shops have now opened throughout the country. Based on overwhelming responses and the desires of numerous inquiries, Parlor developed the required documents and obtained the necessary approvals to begin to offer franchise opportunities to carefully vetted potential franchisees. We are a craft doughnut and coffee shop offering an array of unique bakery items, including our Famous Layered Doughnuts™; vegan/gluten friendly, and keto friendly products; artisanal breakfasts; and specialty coffee. Our goal is to efficiently deliver a superior product, at a moderate price, with exceptional service, in a comfortable setting.

name: Swift-Coles Historic Home
subtitle: A boutique wedding and historic event venue along the Bon Secour River in Bon Secour, Alabama
description: Swift-Coles Historic Home is a wedding venue and historic site located in Bon Secour, Alabama where Schoolhouse Creek runs into Bon Secour River. Originally built by local Creole fisherman, Thomas Gavin, this property dates back to 1882. Although there aren't any photos of the original four room dog-trot style cabin it once was there are multiple live oaks that mark the site of the original setting. Today Swift-Coles is one of the most notable properties in the heart of south Baldwin County with the sweeping avenue of oaks surrounding the 6,000 square foot Tidewater Mansion that was completed in 1908 by the Swift Family. Swift-Coles Historic Home is a a wedding venue and historic site listed on both the National Register of Historic Places and the Alabama Register of Landmarks and Heritage. The home is owned by the Baldwin County Historic Commission. Swift-Coles Historic Home is available for weddings year round and includes access to our bridal suite located inside the home. The property features a multitude of various locations for your wedding day with the ability to say "I do" under sprawling oaks and enjoy cocktail hour along spacious lawns.
